_comment: DSH-NATIVE heterogeneous profile — MiniMax (MiniMax-M3 family) via the INSTALLED CATALOG route `minimax-cn` (CN platform — the `sk-cp-` key format belongs to api.minimaxi.com, not the international `minimax` route) in DSH's own pi-ai adapter (endpoint + protocol + model catalog inherited from pi-ai). Same harness, different LLM, out of process. FILENAME = ROUTE: the pi-ai route name is this file's basename (provider is derived from it, never declared twice). Family label: `_family` = the MODEL LINEAGE (minimax). CREDENTIAL (SHARED-ENV ALIGNMENT 2026-08-25, ADR #54): `_credential_env` points at the CC-convention var MINIMAX_ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN from the one shared .env.solidforge (three-harness file: CC reads it by convention, pi bridges it to its route env via its sf-providers extension, dsh reads it here as the pi-ai apiKeyEnv) — instead of this route's legacy MINIMAX_CN_API_KEY default, so ONE credential arms all three harnesses. This dsh substrate reads ONLY `_credential_env`; `_token_env` (the claude-code-substrate override) is intentionally NOT declared here.
_catalog_verified: 2026-08-14 vs pi.dev (https://pi.dev/models/minimax-cn/minimax-m3?provider=minimax-cn): catalog entry inherited VERBATIM - api anthropic-messages, baseUrl https://api.minimaxi.com/anthropic, reasoning:true, input [text,image], contextWindow 1000000, maxTokens 128000, cost {input 0.3, output 1.2, cacheRead 0.06, cacheWrite 0}. This profile declares ONLY apiKeyEnv; every model fact is catalog-inherited, so it cannot drift from the official docs.
